title: Studio: one vocabulary for an item's state across the pillars, All metadata and Access
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ② filed on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「第二批也立卡」. Priority on 「相关卡 p1, 让车道处理」. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`engine.badge.*` and the directory strings in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/`).
Governs: ADR-0146 D1, D3.
Dedupe: `All metadata badge`, `createOnly`. **New.**
type: enhancement

**Business reason.** The same state has different names by screen, so a person has to learn which screen means what, and "可写" on a read-only package reads as a contradiction.

## What happens

Measured by screenshot on `main` at `3482f3d8d2`, zh-CN, on `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata`.

- The header says 只读 for the package, and its tiles say 可写 on dashboard, report and view, where it means "can be customized". Others say 仅可新建 (`engine.badge.createOnly`).
- The page's lead sentence: 平台协议共暴露 21 个元数据类型（其中 17 个支持运行时覆盖）. "Protocol" and "runtime override" are engineering terms. It also predates ADR-0146's package-level override.
- Pillars use 只读 and 自定义. Access adds OWD, CRUD and `Private 私有`; the review reports these, and whether they belong in this vocabulary is the dev's reading.

## Direction

- One word per state, taken from the pillars: read-only, can be customized, customized, added, switched off. Used on the tiles, badges and marks.
- The tile's word answers "what can I do here", in the package's context.
- The lead sentence states what a person can do, with no count of protocol types.
- Strings and badge mapping only, no new state.

Links back: #29691, ADR-0146 D1, D3.
